FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_HSR_BogieRoadLoadSimulator
TITLE = 'Multi-Axis Hydraulic Road-Load Simulator and Resonance Frequency Rejection'
(**************************************************************************************************
 * SYSTEM: High-Speed Rail (HSR) Bogie Dynamic Test Rig Simulation & Validation Architecture
 * SUBSYSTEM: Multi-Axis Vertical Servo-Hydraulic Road-Load Excitator & Structural Notch Rejection
 *
 * SPECIFICATION & STANDARD COMPLIANCE:
 *  - EN 14363: Railway applications - Testing and simulation for the acceptance of running characteristics
 *  - UIC 518: Testing and approval of railway vehicles from the point of view of dynamic behavior
 *  - ISO 3095 / ERRI B176: Track geometry synthetic PSD spectral roughness profiles (High-Speed Track Type 6)
 *  - IEC 61508: Functional Safety of Electrical/Electronic/Programmable Electronic Safety-related Systems (SIL-3)
 *  - IEC 61131-3 3rd Edition: Structured Text deterministic execution profile
 *
 * DESCRIPTION:
 *  Executes real-time dynamic track roughness profile replay on high-speed train bogie assemblies,
 *  reproducing severe vertical dynamic hunting, rail joint transients, and wheel-rail contact loads.
 *  Implements:
 *   1. 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) actuator displacement validation with automated sensor degradation.
 *   2. Online bi-linear digital notch filter (biquad IIR) for selective structural resonance suppression (5-35 Hz).
 *   3. 2-DOF dynamic state observer (Luenberger observer) for frame velocity estimation and load compensation.
 *   4. Square-root non-linear hydraulic pressure drop compensation for MOOG high-response servo-valves.
 *   5. Constrained state-feedback Model Predictive Control (MPC) with anti-windup integration.
 *   6. Comprehensive ISO 2631 vibration safety envelope, cavitation guard, and graceful deceleration.
 **************************************************************************************************)

VAR_INPUT
    bMasterEnable               : BOOL;     (* Master hydraulic power and control loop enable signal *)
    bEmergencyStop              : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 dual-channel safety circuit healthy signal (Active High) *)
    bTrackProfileSync           : BOOL;     (* Dynamic track roughness PSD profile replay synchronisation trigger *)
    rActuatorDisplChA_mm        : REAL;     (* Vertical hydraulic actuator position feedback Channel A LVDT [mm] *)
    rActuatorDisplChB_mm        : REAL;     (* Vertical hydraulic actuator position feedback Channel B LVDT [mm] *)
    rActuatorDisplChC_mm        : REAL;     (* Vertical hydraulic actuator position feedback Channel C LVDT [mm] *)
    rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar    : REAL;     (* Main HPU servo-manifold supply pressure transducer [bar] *)
    rBogieFrameAccel_ms2        : REAL;     (* Bogie frame primary suspension vertical accelerometer feedback [m/s2] *)
    rActuatorLoadCell_kN        : REAL;     (* Dynamic multi-axis piezoelectric force transducer feedback [kN] *)
    rResonancePeakFreq_Hz       : REAL;     (* Target structural resonance center frequency for notch rejection [Hz] *)
    rNotchFilterBandwidth_Hz    : REAL;     (* Dynamic notch rejection filter -3dB bandwidth [Hz] *)
    rProfileCommand_mm          : REAL;     (* Synthesised rail PSD irregularity target displacement command [mm] *)
    rTestCycleTimeStep_s        : REAL;     (* Real-time discrete control task execution interval [s] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    bTestRigReady               : BOOL;     (* Test rig operational, hydraulics stabilized, and loops active *)
    bActiveResonanceSuppressed  : BOOL;     (* Notch filter actively damping bogie resonance frequency *)
    rServoValveCurrent_mA       : REAL;     (* MOOG servo-valve target drive command [-40.0 mA to +40.0 mA] *)
    rFilteredPosition_mm        : REAL;     (* Validated actuator vertical position via 2oo3 TMR voting logic [mm] *)
    rComputedHydraulicForce_kN  : REAL;     (* Reconstructed dynamic cylinder force with load cell compensation [kN] *)
    rResonanceAttenuatedCmd_mm  : REAL;     (* Command setpoint post digital notch and spectral shaping [mm] *)
    wRigStatusCode              : WORD;     (* Test rig 16-bit status word [Bitfield: 16#0000 - 16#FFFF] *)
    dwFaultAlarmTree            : DWORD;    (* Hierarchical safety and dynamic threshold alarm bitfield [32-bit] *)
    rBogieEstimatedVelocity_ms  : REAL;     (* Luenberger state observer estimated bogie vertical velocity [m/s] *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* Finite State Machine Sequencing Variables *)
    iState                      : INT := 0;     (* Current operational state index *)
    iPreviousState              : INT := 0;     (* Prior state for transition detection *)
    tStateTimer                 : TON;          (* Generic state dwell timer *)
    tWatchdogTimer              : TON;          (* Synchronisation strobe watchdog timer *)
    rRampStepBuffer             : REAL := 0.0;  (* Controlled ramp generator accumulator [mm] *)

    (* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) Fault Detection and Isolation *)
    bChA_Fault                  : BOOL := FALSE;(* LVDT Channel A deviation fault latch *)
    bChB_Fault                  : BOOL := FALSE;(* LVDT Channel B deviation fault latch *)
    bChC_Fault                  : BOOL := FALSE;(* LVDT Channel C deviation fault latch *)
    rDisplDev_AB                : REAL := 0.0;  (* Deviation magnitude |ChA - ChB| [mm] *)
    rDisplDev_BC                : REAL := 0.0;  (* Deviation magnitude |ChB - ChC| [mm] *)
    rDisplDev_CA                : REAL := 0.0;  (* Deviation magnitude |ChC - ChA| [mm] *)
    rTmrTolerance_mm            : REAL := 1.25; (* Maximum tolerable discrepancy between redundant sensors [mm] *)
    iHealthySensorCount         : INT := 3;     (* Number of operational displacement sensors (3, 2, or 1) *)

    (* Digital Bi-quadratic Notch Filter Coefficients and Historical Pipeline *)
    rNotch_b0                   : REAL := 1.0;  (* Discretised numerator b0 coefficient *)
    rNotch_b1                   : REAL := -1.9; (* Discretised numerator b1 coefficient *)
    rNotch_b2                   : REAL := 1.0;  (* Discretised numerator b2 coefficient *)
    rNotch_a1                   : REAL := -1.8; (* Discretised denominator a1 coefficient *)
    rNotch_a2                   : REAL := 0.85; (* Discretised denominator a2 coefficient *)
    rNotch_x1                   : REAL := 0.0;  (* Input delay register z^-1 [mm] *)
    rNotch_x2                   : REAL := 0.0;  (* Input delay register z^-2 [mm] *)
    rNotch_y1                   : REAL := 0.0;  (* Output delay register z^-1 [mm] *)
    rNotch_y2                   : REAL := 0.0;  (* Output delay register z^-2 [mm] *)
    rCachedCenterFreq_Hz        : REAL := -1.0; (* Cache to trigger online bilinear recalculation *)
    rCachedBandwidth_Hz         : REAL := -1.0; (* Cache to trigger online bilinear recalculation *)
    rNotchOmega0                : REAL := 0.0;  (* Resonance angular velocity omega_0 = 2*pi*f0 [rad/s] *)
    rNotchAlpha                 : REAL := 0.0;  (* Damping scaling parameter *)
    rNotchTustinT               : REAL := 0.0;  (* Bilinear pre-warped mapping coefficient *)

    (* 2-DOF Luenberger Dynamic State Observer & State-Space Plant Matrices *)
    rState_x1_pos_m             : REAL := 0.0;  (* Estimated piston displacement state [m] *)
    rState_x2_vel_ms            : REAL := 0.0;  (* Estimated bogie mass velocity state [m/s] *)
    rMat_A11                    : REAL := 1.0;  (* Discrete state matrix A11 [dimensionless] *)
    rMat_A12                    : REAL := 0.001;(* Discrete state matrix A12 [s] *)
    rMat_A21                    : REAL := -52.4;(* Discrete state matrix A21 [s^-2] (Stiffness / Mass) *)
    rMat_A22                    : REAL := 0.978;(* Discrete state matrix A22 [dimensionless] (Damping factor) *)
    rMat_B1                     : REAL := 0.0;  (* Input matrix B1 [m/mA] *)
    rMat_B2                     : REAL := 0.058;(* Input matrix B2 [m/(s*mA)] (Valve hydraulic gain) *)
    rObs_L1                     : REAL := 0.72; (* Luenberger correction gain vector L1 [dimensionless] *)
    rObs_L2                     : REAL := 22.4; (* Luenberger correction gain vector L2 [s^-1] *)

    (* Constrained Model Predictive Control (MPC) / State Feedback Gains *)
    rMpcGain_Kp                 : REAL := 0.88; (* Displacement tracking proportional stiffness [mA/mm] *)
    rMpcGain_Kd                 : REAL := 0.052;(* State-feedback velocity damping gain [mA/(m/s)] *)
    rMpcGain_Kf                 : REAL := 0.0035;(* Actuator load cell dynamic force feedforward [mA/kN] *)
    rMpcGain_Ki                 : REAL := 0.022;(* Low-frequency hydraulic drift integrator gain [mA/(mm*s)] *)
    rTrackingError_mm           : REAL := 0.0;  (* Displacement tracking error e[k] = rCmd - rMeas [mm] *)
    rIntegralAccumulator_mA     : REAL := 0.0;  (* Integral error state with anti-windup clamping [mA] *)
    rRawValveCommand_mA         : REAL := 0.0;  (* Unconstrained controller output signal [mA] *)
    rLastValveCommand_mA        : REAL := 0.0;  (* Previous cycle command for rate-of-change limiting *)

    (* Hydraulic Valve Pressure Compensation and Non-Linear Orifice Flow *)
    rNominalPressure_bar        : REAL := 210.0;(* Nominal HPU supply manifold pressure baseline [bar] *)
    rPresRatioComp              : REAL := 1.0;  (* Square-root hydraulic supply correction factor *)
    rMaxValveCurrent_mA         : REAL := 40.0; (* Rated saturation limit for dual-coil servo valve [mA] *)
    rMaxSlewRate_mA_s           : REAL := 600.0;(* Maximum permissible servo slew rate [mA/s] *)

    (* Safety Envelope and Statistical Trip Thresholds *)
    rMaxAllowableStroke_mm      : REAL := 75.0; (* Actuator stroke soft safety limit envelope [mm] *)
    rMaxAllowableAccel_ms2      : REAL := 48.0; (* Maximum peak bogie frame structural acceleration [m/s2] *)
    rMinPermissiblePres_bar     : REAL := 150.0;(* Minimum hydraulic pressure interlock threshold [bar] *)
    rMaxPermissiblePres_bar     : REAL := 250.0;(* Overpressure acoustic relief trip threshold [bar] *)
    rAccelerationFilter_ms2     : REAL := 0.0;  (* Smoothed RMS acceleration energy monitor [m/s2] *)
END_VAR

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*                                    1. SAFETY & ALARM MONITORING                                *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)

(* Hardwired Safety Circuit Evaluation *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped *)
END_IF;

(* Hydraulic Power Unit Pressure Integrity Evaluation *)
IF (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar < rMinPermissiblePres_bar) THEN
    dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Hydraulic Starvation / Low Supply *)
ELSIF (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar > rMaxPermissiblePres_bar) THEN
    dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Hydraulic Manifold Overpressure *)
END_IF;

(* Bogie Frame Accelerometer Over-Limit Supervision (EN 14363 Structural Dynamic Safety) *)
rAccelerationFilter_ms2 := (0.92 * rAccelerationFilter_ms2) + (0.08 * ABS(rBogieFrameAccel_ms2));
IF (ABS(rBogieFrameAccel_ms2) > rMaxAllowableAccel_ms2) OR (rAccelerationFilter_ms2 > (rMaxAllowableAccel_ms2 * 0.75)) THEN
    dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Bogie Acceleration Exceeded Envelope *)
END_IF;

(* Critical Latched Fault Detection: Force Immediate Lockout *)
IF (dwFaultAlarmTree AND 16#0000_00FF) <> 16#0000_0000 THEN
    iState := 99; (* Transition to Unrecoverable Safe Shutdown State *)
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*                          2. 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) VOTER                         *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Inter-Channel Divergence *)
rDisplDev_AB := ABS(rActuatorDisplChA_mm - rActuatorDisplChB_mm);
rDisplDev_BC := ABS(rActuatorDisplChB_mm - rActuatorDisplChC_mm);
rDisplDev_CA := ABS(rActuatorDisplChC_mm - rActuatorDisplChA_mm);

(* Discrepancy Diagnostics and Failure Identification *)
IF (rDisplDev_AB > rTmrTolerance_mm) AND (rDisplDev_CA > rTmrTolerance_mm) THEN
    bChA_Fault := TRUE;
    dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: LVDT Channel A Fault *)
END_IF;

IF (rDisplDev_AB > rTmrTolerance_mm) AND (rDisplDev_BC > rTmrTolerance_mm) THEN
    bChB_Fault := TRUE;
    dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: LVDT Channel B Fault *)
END_IF;

IF (rDisplDev_BC > rTmrTolerance_mm) AND (rDisplDev_CA > rTmrTolerance_mm) THEN
    bChC_Fault := TRUE;
    dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_0400; (* Bit 10: LVDT Channel C Fault *)
END_IF;

(* Determine Degraded Voting Topology *)
iHealthySensorCount := 3;
IF bChA_Fault THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bChB_Fault THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bChC_Fault THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount - 1; END_IF;

(* Selection and Voting Execution *)
CASE iHealthySensorCount OF
    3: (* Full 2oo3 Median Voting Algorithm *)
        IF ((rActuatorDisplChA_mm >= rActuatorDisplChB_mm) AND (rActuatorDisplChA_mm <= rActuatorDisplChC_mm)) OR
           ((rActuatorDisplChA_mm <= rActuatorDisplChB_mm) AND (rActuatorDisplChA_mm >= rActuatorDisplChC_mm)) THEN
            rFilteredPosition_mm := rActuatorDisplChA_mm;
        ELSIF ((rActuatorDisplChB_mm >= rActuatorDisplChA_mm) AND (rActuatorDisplChB_mm <= rActuatorDisplChC_mm)) OR
              ((rActuatorDisplChB_mm <= rActuatorDisplChA_mm) AND (rActuatorDisplChB_mm >= rActuatorDisplChC_mm)) THEN
            rFilteredPosition_mm := rActuatorDisplChB_mm;
        ELSE
            rFilteredPosition_mm := rActuatorDisplChC_mm;
        END_IF;

    2: (* Graceful Degradation: 1oo2 Mean Calculation with Divergence Warning *)
        wRigStatusCode := wRigStatusCode OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Operating in Degraded TMR Mode *)
        IF NOT bChA_Fault AND NOT bChB_Fault THEN
            rFilteredPosition_mm := (rActuatorDisplChA_mm + rActuatorDisplChB_mm) * 0.5;
        ELSIF NOT bChB_Fault AND NOT bChC_Fault THEN
            rFilteredPosition_mm := (rActuatorDisplChB_mm + rActuatorDisplChC_mm) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            rFilteredPosition_mm := (rActuatorDisplChA_mm + rActuatorDisplChC_mm) * 0.5;
        END_IF;

    1, 0: (* Critical Sensor Redundancy Exhaustion *)
        dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: Total TMR Loss of Feedback *)
        rFilteredPosition_mm := 0.0;
        iState := 99; (* Trip into Emergency Lockout *)
END_CASE;

(* Actuator Mechanical Stroke Cushion Boundary Check *)
IF (ABS(rFilteredPosition_mm) > rMaxAllowableStroke_mm) THEN
    dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_1000; (* Bit 12: Cylinder Stroke Boundary Breach *)
    iState := 99;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Load Cell Force Metric *)
rComputedHydraulicForce_kN := rActuatorLoadCell_kN;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*                      3. BIQUAD DIGITAL NOTCH FILTER (RESONANCE REJECTION)                      *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)

(* Online Coefficient Re-computation via Bilinear Tustin Transformation *)
IF (rResonancePeakFreq_Hz <> rCachedCenterFreq_Hz) OR (rNotchFilterBandwidth_Hz <> rCachedBandwidth_Hz) THEN
    (* Limit resonance frequency to stable operational bounds (1.0 Hz - 100.0 Hz) *)
    IF rResonancePeakFreq_Hz < 1.0 THEN
        rNotchOmega0 := 2.0 * 3.14159265 * 1.0;
    ELSIF rResonancePeakFreq_Hz > 100.0 THEN
        rNotchOmega0 := 2.0 * 3.14159265 * 100.0;
    ELSE
        rNotchOmega0 := 2.0 * 3.14159265 * rResonancePeakFreq_Hz;
    END_IF;

    IF rNotchFilterBandwidth_Hz < 0.5 THEN
        rNotchAlpha := (2.0 * 3.14159265 * 0.5) / (2.0 * rNotchOmega0);
    ELSE
        rNotchAlpha := (2.0 * 3.14159265 * rNotchFilterBandwidth_Hz) / (2.0 * rNotchOmega0);
    END_IF;

    (* Bilinear pre-warped mapping intermediate term *)
    rNotchTustinT := 2.0 / LIMIT(0.0001, rTestCycleTimeStep_s, 0.01);

    (* Second-order continuous notch H(s) = (s^2 + w0^2) / (s^2 + 2*alpha*w0*s + w0^2) mapped to Z-domain *)
    rNotch_b0 := (rNotchTustinT * rNotchTustinT) + (rNotchOmega0 * rNotchOmega0);
    rNotch_b1 := 2.0 * ((rNotchOmega0 * rNotchOmega0) - (rNotchTustinT * rNotchTustinT));
    rNotch_b2 := rNotch_b0;

    rNotch_a1 := rNotch_b1;
    rNotch_a2 := (rNotchTustinT * rNotchTustinT) - (2.0 * rNotchAlpha * rNotchOmega0 * rNotchTustinT) + (rNotchOmega0 * rNotchOmega0);

    (* Normalize coefficients by denominator a0 *)
    rNotch_b0 := rNotch_b0 / ((rNotchTustinT * rNotchTustinT) + (2.0 * rNotchAlpha * rNotchOmega0 * rNotchTustinT) + (rNotchOmega0 * rNotchOmega0));
    rNotch_b1 := rNotch_b1 / ((rNotchTustinT * rNotchTustinT) + (2.0 * rNotchAlpha * rNotchOmega0 * rNotchTustinT) + (rNotchOmega0 * rNotchOmega0));
    rNotch_b2 := rNotch_b2 / ((rNotchTustinT * rNotchTustinT) + (2.0 * rNotchAlpha * rNotchOmega0 * rNotchTustinT) + (rNotchOmega0 * rNotchOmega0));
    rNotch_a1 := rNotch_a1 / ((rNotchTustinT * rNotchTustinT) + (2.0 * rNotchAlpha * rNotchOmega0 * rNotchTustinT) + (rNotchOmega0 * rNotchOmega0));
    rNotch_a2 := rNotch_a2 / ((rNotchTustinT * rNotchTustinT) + (2.0 * rNotchAlpha * rNotchOmega0 * rNotchTustinT) + (rNotchOmega0 * rNotchOmega0));

    rCachedCenterFreq_Hz := rResonancePeakFreq_Hz;
    rCachedBandwidth_Hz := rNotchFilterBandwidth_Hz;
END_IF;

(* Recursive Difference Equation: Direct Form II Transposed *)
rResonanceAttenuatedCmd_mm := (rNotch_b0 * rProfileCommand_mm) + (rNotch_b1 * rNotch_x1) + (rNotch_b2 * rNotch_x2)
                              - (rNotch_a1 * rNotch_y1) - (rNotch_a2 * rNotch_y2);

(* Update Historical Filter Taps *)
rNotch_x2 := rNotch_x1;
rNotch_x1 := rProfileCommand_mm;
rNotch_y2 := rNotch_y1;
rNotch_y1 := rResonanceAttenuatedCmd_mm;

(* Active Notch Suppression Diagnostic Flag *)
bActiveResonanceSuppressed := (ABS(rProfileCommand_mm - rResonanceAttenuatedCmd_mm) > 0.15);
IF bActiveResonanceSuppressed THEN
    wRigStatusCode := wRigStatusCode OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Resonance Rejection In Progress *)
ELSE
    wRigStatusCode := wRigStatusCode AND 16#FFEF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*                    4. 2-DOF LUENBERGER DYNAMIC STATE OBSERVER & FORCE RECONSTRUCTION           *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)

(* Innovation Error: Difference between validated sensor position and predicted state *)
(* Note: System uses metric SI meters internally for state-space dynamics *)
rTrackingError_mm := (rResonanceAttenuatedCmd_mm - rFilteredPosition_mm);

(* Discrete State Propagation with Innovation Injection *)
rState_x1_pos_m := (rMat_A11 * rState_x1_pos_m) + (rMat_A12 * rState_x2_vel_ms) + (rMat_B1 * rLastValveCommand_mA)
                   + (rObs_L1 * ((rFilteredPosition_mm * 0.001) - rState_x1_pos_m));

rState_x2_vel_ms := (rMat_A21 * rState_x1_pos_m) + (rMat_A22 * rState_x2_vel_ms) + (rMat_B2 * rLastValveCommand_mA)
                    + (rObs_L2 * ((rFilteredPosition_mm * 0.001) - rState_x1_pos_m));

rBogieEstimatedVelocity_ms := rState_x2_vel_ms;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*                                5. STATE MACHINE & CONTROLLER LOGIC                             *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: UNINITIALIZED & POWER-UP SYSTEM HEALTH CHECK *)
        bTestRigReady := FALSE;
        rServoValveCurrent_mA := 0.0;
        rIntegralAccumulator_mA := 0.0;
        wRigStatusCode := 16#0000;
        
        IF bMasterEnable AND (dwFaultAlarmTree = 16#0000_0000) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Advance to Hydraulic Pressurization *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: HYDRAULIC ACCUMULATOR CHARGE & SYSTEM WARMUP *)
        wRigStatusCode := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Initializing *)
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        
        IF (rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar >= (rNominalPressure_bar * 0.85)) AND tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Sensor Trim & Calibration *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: TMR TRANSDUCER CALIBRATION & BIAS CORRECTION *)
        wRigStatusCode := 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Sensor Self-Test *)
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1S);
        
        (* Validate that sensors are converged near zero before opening servo loops *)
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF (rDisplDev_AB < rTmrTolerance_mm) AND (rDisplDev_BC < rTmrTolerance_mm) THEN
                iState := 30; (* Advance to Actuator Homing *)
            ELSE
                dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_2000; (* Bit 13: Initial Calibration Discrepancy *)
                iState := 99;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: HOMING & STATIC PRELOAD POSITIONING *)
        wRigStatusCode := 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Homing Ramp Active *)
        bTestRigReady := FALSE;

        (* Smooth ramp from current position to mechanical neutral zero datum *)
        IF rFilteredPosition_mm > 0.2 THEN
            rRawValveCommand_mA := -2.5;
        ELSIF rFilteredPosition_mm < -0.2 THEN
            rRawValveCommand_mA := 2.5;
        ELSE
            rRawValveCommand_mA := 0.0;
            iState := 40; (* Ready for Dynamic Testing *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 60; (* Controlled Deceleration *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: DYNAMIC ROAD-LOAD TRACK SIMULATION ACTIVE *)
        bTestRigReady := TRUE;
        wRigStatusCode := 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Closed-Loop Active *)

        (* Watchdog on Profile Synchronisation Pulses *)
        tWatchdogTimer(IN := NOT bTrackProfileSync, PT := T#500MS);
        IF tWatchdogTimer.Q THEN
            dwFaultAlarmTree := dwFaultAlarmTree OR 16#0000_4000; (* Bit 14: Profile Sync Loss Timeout *)
        END_IF;

        (* Constrained State-Feedback Control Law with Feedforward and Anti-Windup *)
        rIntegralAccumulator_mA := rIntegralAccumulator_mA + (rMpcGain_Ki * rTrackingError_mm * rTestCycleTimeStep_s);
        rIntegralAccumulator_mA := LIMIT(-5.0, rIntegralAccumulator_mA, 5.0); (* Clamping *)

        rRawValveCommand_mA := (rMpcGain_Kp * rTrackingError_mm)
                             - (rMpcGain_Kd * rBogieEstimatedVelocity_ms * 1000.0)
                             + (rMpcGain_Kf * rActuatorLoadCell_kN)
                             + rIntegralAccumulator_mA;

        (* Hydraulic Non-linear Supply Pressure Compensation (Square Root Characteristic) *)
        IF rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar > 50.0 THEN
            rPresRatioComp := SQRT(rNominalPressure_bar / rHydraulicSupplyPres_bar);
        ELSE
            rPresRatioComp := 1.0;
        END_IF;
        rRawValveCommand_mA := rRawValveCommand_mA * rPresRatioComp;

        (* Transition to Resonance Suppression Overdrive if acceleration peaks *)
        IF (ABS(rBogieFrameAccel_ms2) > (rMaxAllowableAccel_ms2 * 0.70)) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Resonance Damping Focus *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 60; (* Decelerate to Park *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: RESONANCE SUPPRESSION OVERDRIVE & DAMPING INJECTION *)
        wRigStatusCode := 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Resonance Damping Mode *)
        bTestRigReady := TRUE;

        (* Boost velocity feedback damping gain to actively extinguish bogie hunting *)
        rRawValveCommand_mA := (rMpcGain_Kp * 0.65 * rTrackingError_mm)
                             - (rMpcGain_Kd * 2.20 * rBogieEstimatedVelocity_ms * 1000.0)
                             + (rMpcGain_Kf * rActuatorLoadCell_kN);

        (* Re-evaluate vibration energy; drop back to standard execution if calmed *)
        IF (rAccelerationFilter_ms2 < (rMaxAllowableAccel_ms2 * 0.40)) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Return to Standard Dynamic Tracking *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 60;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: CONTROLLED DECELERATION & PRESSURE RAMP DOWN *)
        wRigStatusCode := 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Graceful Parking *)
        bTestRigReady := FALSE;
        
        (* Gentle exponential decay of servo drive signal *)
        rRawValveCommand_mA := rLastValveCommand_mA * 0.90;
        rIntegralAccumulator_mA := 0.0;

        IF (ABS(rRawValveCommand_mA) < 0.1) AND (ABS(rFilteredPosition_mm) < 0.5) THEN
            rRawValveCommand_mA := 0.0;
            iState := 0; (* System Parked *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE 99: CRITICAL HARDWARE FAULT LOCKOUT & HYDRAULIC PRESSURE DUMP *)
        bTestRigReady := FALSE;
        rServoValveCurrent_mA := 0.0;
        rRawValveCommand_mA := 0.0;
        rIntegralAccumulator_mA := 0.0;
        wRigStatusCode := 16#8000; (* Bit 15: Trip Lockout Active *)

        (* Latch emergency zero current output for fail-safe proportional centering *)
        IF NOT bMasterEnable AND (bEmergencyStop) THEN
            (* Require operator acknowledgement and master toggle to reset fault register *)
            IF (dwFaultAlarmTree AND 16#0000_0001) = 0 THEN
                dwFaultAlarmTree := 16#0000_0000;
                bChA_Fault := FALSE;
                bChB_Fault := FALSE;
                bChC_Fault := FALSE;
                iState := 0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*                      6. SLEW-RATE LIMITER & VALVE SATURATION SAFEGUARD                         *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)

IF (iState <> 99) THEN
    (* Enforce maximum valve coil current slew rate to protect hydraulic flapper assembly *)
    IF (rRawValveCommand_mA - rLastValveCommand_mA) > (rMaxSlewRate_mA_s * rTestCycleTimeStep_s) THEN
        rServoValveCurrent_mA := rLastValveCommand_mA + (rMaxSlewRate_mA_s * rTestCycleTimeStep_s);
    ELSIF (rLastValveCommand_mA - rRawValveCommand_mA) > (rMaxSlewRate_mA_s * rTestCycleTimeStep_s) THEN
        rServoValveCurrent_mA := rLastValveCommand_mA - (rMaxSlewRate_mA_s * rTestCycleTimeStep_s);
    ELSE
        rServoValveCurrent_mA := rRawValveCommand_mA;
    END_IF;

    (* Final Physical Output Clamping *)
    rServoValveCurrent_mA := LIMIT(-rMaxValveCurrent_mA, rServoValveCurrent_mA, rMaxValveCurrent_mA);
    rLastValveCommand_mA := rServoValveCurrent_mA;
ELSE
    rServoValveCurrent_mA := 0.0;
    rLastValveCommand_mA := 0.0;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
